items.rationale: Clauses 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f) exclude translation for claim substantiation even when the police report is required. The conditional estimate is 68 lines × €2.50 gross.
Clauses 7.1.8(e)–(f) exclude the provider’s working materials and ancillary charges attached to the excluded translation. The conditional estimate is €10 for the single charge.

items.description: Robbery loss: Tudor day-date watch and cash
items.rationale: Part 11 confirms insured robbery away from home; the photographed Tudor day-date watch is estimated to reach the €2,500 unscheduled per-item limit under 4.2.2, and the cash loss above €800 reaches the €500 limit under 4.2.3. The €3,000 subtotal is below the €5,000 away-from-home limit, leaving €2,950 after the single €50 deductible under 7.8.
Clause 7.1.8(b) excludes forwarding charges even when billed on the covered property settlement statement. The conditional estimate is €26 for one charge, based on the shipping prior.
